title: Alpha-convex functions in complex Banach spaces
summary: Let $\mathbb{B}$ be the unit ball in a complex Banach space ${\mathbb X}$. We study biholomorphic mappings $F: \mathbb{B} \to {\mathbb X}$ of the form $F(z) = f(z)z$ for $z \in \mathbb{B}$, where $f: \mathbb{B} \to \mathbb{C}$ is a holomorphic function satisfying $f(0) = 1$. Our main contributions are as follows: Inclusion Results: We establish inclusion conditions for $\mathcal{M}_α(\mathbb{B})$, class of $α$-convex functions in $\mathbb{B}$ to belong to the classes of starlike mappings or quasi-convex mappings of type $B$ on $\mathbb{B}$ for specified ranges of $α$.
